text:
- If target NOT_SEEN, locate with visual description; grasp top-down at body centre across narrow side.
- Place target "in" basket. If UNREACHABLE, handover/switch arm and retry; if OFF_TARGET, re-grasp and place again. Accept place OK/RELEASED_NOT_SEEN even if target later not visible; do not require an "in" check then.
- Grasp basket with opposite arm by handle; verify result/image shows "handle arching over top" and point on basket. If "no thin protrusion" or far point, retry other arm/re-locate; do not proceed.
- Lift/move basket with relative dz 3-5 cm; verify holding, basket height ~3-4 cm, and target in basket if visible. If target not visible, verify only holding/height after a prior place OK.
- Call done only after these verifications pass; do not move basket until target placement is OK.
goal: Target released in basket; opposite arm holds basket by valid handle; basket lifted about 3-4 cm.
